newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat group registrations up 20 pct in Dec.
newsitem.headline: Fiat group registrations up 20 pct in Dec.

text.p: Italian carmaker Fiat posted a 20 percent rise in new car registrations in December but registrations for the whole year 1996 slipped 3.09 percent, Transport Ministry data showed.
The Fiat Auto group, comprising the marques Fiat, Alfa Romeo, Lancia Autobianchi and Fiat-Innocenti, saw new registrations in December totalling 48,250 units against 40,208 in December 1995.
For the full 1996 year, group registrations declined by 3.09 percent to 761,892 from 786,196. Total Italian new registrations rose 0.34 percent to 1,737,262 units.
